data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis F7): alert_store.append writes under bridge_state/bridge_alerts/. The parent epic's Approach says 'All bridge_state/ write paths removed' — this STORY uses alert_store for audit-only writes (trash_restore + out_of_window). RESOLUTION: explicitly carve out bridge_alerts as audit-not-state (alerts are operator-visible signals, not reconciler state used for convergence). Document this carve-out in T3's commit message AND in T4's KNOWN-ISSUES.md entry. If a future compliance gate flags this, the carve-out is the authoritative answer.
